## Summary

Describe the change and the affected features.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant build/typecheck/tests run, or limitations explained.
- [ ] Existing authentication, project permissions, and data behavior checked where applicable.

## UI / HCI checklist (complete if frontend UI changed)

- [ ] Reused `frontend/src/styles/theme.css` tokens, shared components, typography and spacing; no arbitrary new palette.
- [ ] Used responsive grids; checked mobile, tablet and desktop widths for overflow and alignment.
- [ ] Checked keyboard navigation, focus states, labels, contrast and tap targets.
- [ ] Included appropriate loading, empty, error, success and validation feedback.
- [ ] Checked chart labels, KPI units and table readability where applicable.
- [ ] Compared the change against `frontend/guidelines/Guidelines.md`.

If no UI changed, write **UI: not applicable** in the summary.
